unconfirmed: Roadmap 'Next' items (more private builds; pilot beds to full farms; a private catalogue by invitation) were written as plausible directions.
'What happens next' steps on Start a project (we read the brief; a short call; a written plan) are suggested wording.

Field-note captions now follow the ledger wording ('over about 250 years', 'Renaissance, embossed and gilt steel, made for display', dosing channels 'Visible on the feeding rig'); the shipped page had looser wording.
Brief sending states on Start a project ('Sending…'; 'Brief sent.'; 'It is on its way to lastfomo@gmail.com.') are suggested wording, added when the form began emailing the brief.

The Hortus hardware shop (site/shop.json) is a demonstration for the owner, shown in the Artifact only ('live': false). Its English copy is translated from the maker's Russian pages and is suggested wording: product lines, the hardware screen, 'How ordering works', the basket and order wording ('Nothing is charged here', 'We confirm stock, delivery and payment by email').
Shop prices are E-MODE's list prices in roubles on 25 October 2026 (shop/source/emode.json). The owner sets the selling price and currency before the shop goes live.

Explore (#/explore, site/explore.js) is suggested interface wording: the settings ('Auto walk', 'Visits every signal for you, wing by wing.', 'Music', 'The score of each wing.', 'Sounds', 'Steps, signals and arches.', 'Look with your phone', 'Walk to', 'How to walk'), the toasts ('Auto walk is on. Press the round button to walk yourself.', 'Your phone did not share its motion here. Drag to look around.') and the round button's 'Auto' and 'Hold to walk'. The signal panels carry the walking experience's copy; the San Gennaro panel now says 'over about 250 years', as the ledger does.

conflicts.site: the header carried the lockup (horse and wordmark)
